dataSources.title: Data sources
dataSources.intro: Discover Slovenia AI uses the following data sources to bring you reliable information about Slovenian tourist destinations.

osm.desc: POI data (points of interest) — attractions, museums, restaurants, hotels, viewpoints, natural landmarks, religious sites. Licence: ODbL.

wikipedia.desc: Descriptions of destinations and POIs. Licence: CC BY-SA.

openMeteo.desc: Real-time weather data. Free API with no key required.

zai.desc: AI itinerary generation based on user preferences.

sloveniaInfo.desc: Official tourism content from I feel Slovenia (Slovenian Tourist Board) — 664 structured sources from the slovenia.info llms.txt index, used by the AI as grounded answer context with citations. Updated: September 2026.

dataSources.supplyIntro: Each provider's status is derived directly from our provider registry — a single source of truth that also powers the supply map. Our honesty principle: a partner link is NOT inventory — live offers (prices, availability) appear only once API access is actually approved and connected.
dataSources.providersText: Details about local providers (hotels, restaurants, activities, products, experiences) are contributed by registered providers through the B2B portal. Each provider is responsible for the accuracy of their own details.
